Description: Caster studies a person for use with disguise spells later on this list. The caster can only have as many disguises studied as he has levels
Changes the visual appearance of one object. The target of the spell must be no larger than 10 pounds per level of the caster
Caster has a limited illusion on himself that allows him to look like any humanoid race within 20% of his own size. The illusion moves as the caster moves

All deeds performed (while this spell is active) are "shadowed" to divination spells. For the purposes of a divination spell, the information gained about the caster will be shrouded in shadows. For example, a Death's Memory cast on the scene of a murder might reveal a shadowy figure performing the deeds (but no details about the identity of the figure)
For the purposes of mental or magical detections, the caster appears to be of any race he chooses (racial type must be selected at the time of casting)
As Facade I, except one extra sense is added
Caster physically changes to take on the form and visual appearance of any one studied person. This is strictly a physical change. The cster must already have cast a Study Disguise on this person

As Shadow Assassin, except absolutely no information about the caster will be revealed. For example, a Death's Memory cast on the scen of a murder might show the victim collapsing with a knife in his chest (but no sign of the assassin)
As Facade I, except two extra senses are added
As Disguise I, except caster also takes on the vocal characteristics (i.e., he sounds like the person)
As Misfeel Kind, except caster appears to be of any profession he chooses
aster may mentally speak with one target; to the target it will seem as if they are communicating normally (i.e., verbally)

As Disguise II, except caster also takes on the obvious mannerisms of the person. For example, if the person was left-handed, the caster is left-handed; if the person has a limp, the caster will have a limp
As Facade I, except all senses are included
As Misfeel Kind, except caster appears to be of any level he chooses (ranging from first level to twice his actual level)
As Disguise III, except caster also takes on subtle mannerisms of the person. This makes him virtually undetectable to all but the closest of associates
As Misfeel Kind, except caster appears to have no presence (for presence detecting spells)
As Shadow Assassin, except all deeds performed while this spell is active will appear as if the currently studied patsy is performing them (see Study Patsy on Assassination Mastery)
As Disguise IV, except even very subtle mannerisms are gained
As all of the Misfeel spells on this list at the same time
Caster and objects on his person cannot be detected by any Detect... spells
As Misfeel, except caster need not concentrate
Caster may use any lower level spell on this list, one per round. MAGENT BASE 4.6.2 DISGUISE MASTERY
